name: 読書の表示を変えるシート
prompt:
Generate one isolated Japanese reading appearance settings sheet, high-resolution polished flat UI on pure-white canvas. ORIGINAL input1 Speechify screenshot is PRIMARY authority for icon glyph geometry, proportions, stroke/optical weight, spacing, alignment, fine controls. Saved Japanese mock input2 is SECONDARY Japanese wording/overall layout only: it omits many original icons and has inaccurate mint fills. Input3 is approved Lighthouse styling only, no bus subject.
Reconstruct only original settings bottom sheet, source region x0 y868 width1180 height1591 in full screenshot. No phone/document/header/footer branding. About390x520 logical units, compact readable hierarchy, rounded top corners.
Official style: purewhite page/sheet and ALL ordinary cards/controls; fine neutral outlines and dividers, restrained shadows, no lavender/gray sheet wash, no mint surfaces. Primary active control forest gradient #174C36 to #1F6444 to #2D8F5E. Supporting icons coherent slate #526173, follow original geometry, not rough mock symbols. Theme preview fills warmcream and papergray retained because they preview real reading themes.
Exact Japanese text and typography, Meiryo, letterspacing0:
Title 「表示を変更」 Bold20 line28, top-right small white outlined circular close button with original rounded X slate.
Row1 two rounded controls: left 「小」 Regular14/24, 「19」 Regular12/16, 「大」 Regular20/28; preserve original tiny vertical divider ticks above/below19. Right control includes original half-black/half-white appearance circle, label 「端末の設定」 Regular14/24 and original stacked up/down chevrons at right; these were omitted by mock, restore them.
Row2 three equal theme tiles, heights84. First selected: white interior forest outline, original document icon with three short horizontal marks above 「基本」. Second original warm-cream fill and small steaming cup outline above 「温かい」. Third original paper lightgray fill and small rolled paper sheet outline above 「紙」. All labels Regular14/24. Icons source-shaped slate.
Next row 「資料にもテーマを適用」 Regular14/24, ON toggle at right with forest track and white thumb RIGHT.
Next three-way mode control, white neutral outlined housing, selected left section white with subtle inset boundary/shadow, inactive sections also white. Restore original small mode glyph before each label: vertical document/scroll glyph before 「スクロール」; page with folded lower corner before 「めくる」; overlapping page with left arrow before 「スライド」. All Regular12/16, selected text dark, inactive mutedslate. Fit without overlap using compact original spacing.
Next rounded white group two rows separated by neutral hairline: 「書体」 left, 「メイリオ」 muted right and small original right chevron; second row 「太字」 left and OFF neutral toggle with white thumb LEFT. Text Regular14/24, not bold.
Footnote exactly 「元の資料表示には一部の設定が適用されません。」 Regular12/16 muted, one readable line. Do not add anything. Match actual selected states; no extra options or English. Preserve source icons carefully, keep exact Japanese native content, hierarchy and metrics. Static raster concept only.
reviewNotes: Original detail hierarchy applied. Output reviewed: source icons mostly restored, white ordinary surfaces, theme cream/paper functional samples, correct ON/OFF states. Body/mode/value labels visibly heavier than locked Regular roles and Scroll glyph lacks separate vertical tick. Targeted correction follows; every attempt retained. Agent raster review only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
